title: Padding preserves machine runs
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $K$ be a natural number with $k\le K$, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, running the machine padded to $K$ work tapes for $n$ steps from the padded configuration gives the padding of the configuration reached by running $M$ from $c$ for $n$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
